column1: # PB-SEC-3 log-sink inventory. GENERATED by `go test ./android/gate/ -run TestPBSEC3 -update-logscan`.
# Every logging call site on the PHONE-SIDE path (the Kotlin app, the bound facade,
# the phone core). The daemon, the relay server and the TUI are deliberately out of
# scope: they log at length and they do not run on the handset.
# Columns: area <TAB> file:line <TAB> the call <TAB> the reviewer's note on the file
# The note is not decoration: a sink in a file with no note fails the artifact test,
# in -update mode too, so a new call site cannot be regenerated into a green.

column3: Log.w(TAG, "push token fetch failed; this launch registered no token and the " + "phone will not receive background wakes until the next one", e)
column4: PB-PUSH-5's graceful-and-loud degradation, both arms: static prose plus the caught Throwable. No token value is in scope on either path -- getInstance() threw because this build configures no Firebase project, or the asynchronous fetch failed and produced none.
